title: 第二十三章咱们的儿子就叫李惊雷吧第二十四章极品雷灵根叶英俊登门拜访
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 皇宫不远处，一座由琉璃火晶打造的宫殿内，一名小太监发出一声惊恐的尖叫。
这一声尖叫，瞬间让整座皇宫引起了不小的骚动。
上朝的五大家族，丞相各位尚书，就连当今皇帝也都到场。
看着被反噬而死的星宿宰相，他们全都瞪大双眼，忍不住打了个寒颤。
那可是合体巅峰，接近渡劫期的强者啊！
他的身死无异于皇室断掉一条粗犷的手臂，就连当今皇帝谢天龙都心疼不已。
众人的目光全都看向小太监，这让他唰的一下跪倒在地，不断地磕头。
“星宿宰相看梁国境内闪过紫气环绕的异象，认为是有至宝出世，这才忍不住想要推演一下。”
“想不到直接就……”
有了小太监的叙述，在场的各位全都明白了来龙去脉。
“能够将星宿宰相反噬而死的，这件至宝的品级说不定在天阶，各位爱卿有何见解？”
谢天龙身穿黄袍，身边有龙气环绕，宰相的死让他感到无比的震怒。
恐怖的威压宛如太古神山，压得五大家族全都低下头，骨骼劈啪作响。
“回陛下，您都说这件至宝的品级在天阶，岂是我们能够染指的。”一名叶家长老站出来，惶恐不已。
其他四大家族的脸上也全都和叶家一样，露出一副死人脸。
这般态度谢天龙明白他们心里各怀鬼胎，袖袍一挥示意他们退下。
“星宿宰相多年立下汗马功劳，厚葬全城哀嚎三天。”
在安排完星宿之后，谢天龙果断地将皇宫另一名推演天机的宰相召进。
周一星实力虽然只有合体后期，可推演之力仅仅比星宿稍微逊色。
“参见陛下。”周一星走入大殿，躬身拜见。
“你作为天机师本皇也不给你废话了，推演看看。”
谢天龙声音刚刚落下，一声跪地声就回荡在整个皇宫。
这一声似乎是刻意为之，声音相当之大，紧随其后的就是梨花带雨的哭声。
“还请陛下收回成命，星宿都没了，属下上有老下有小，还不想死啊！！”
求饶之声回荡皇宫，这让谢天龙一脸黑线，不明白对方为什么会这么大反应。
“朕只是让你推演看看，五大家族这次之行会不会有所收获？”
“原来就这，还以为陛下要……”
“你以为是什么？”谢天龙凑上前质问。
“没事没事，这就推演。”周一星连忙摆手，随后手中多出一个手掌大小的蓝色球体。
近一点看去，倒像是一副浩瀚星河游荡。
“星河天机球，助我一臂之力吧！”
周一星闭上眼睛，因果之力覆盖整个皇宫，一幅幅画面浮现在他的脑海。
谢天龙就坐在龙椅上，手掌扶着侧脸静静等待着。
大约过了两刻钟的时间，周一星睁开眼睛，谄媚地说道：“嘿嘿嘿，这五大家族到头来就是空跑一趟，连一根毛都找不到，还有可能惹得一身骚。”
如此，谢天龙就松了口气，正当他打算继续开口时，周一星伸出手指连忙打断。
“陛下是想问如果你亲自去收获如何吧！”
“很遗憾，任凭陛下有龙气加持一样是空跑一趟，据我推算，那件至宝已经被一名实力远超于咱们的大能拿走了。”
周一星得意洋洋，说得振振有词。
content_en:
Not far from the palace, in a palace made of glazed fire crystals, a young eunuch let out a terrified scream.
This scream instantly caused quite a commotion throughout the palace.
The five major families of the previous dynasty, the prime ministers, ministers, and even the current emperor were also present.
Looking at Prime Minister Xingxu who was killed by the backlash, they all widened their eyes and couldn't help but shudder.
That is the peak of integration, a strong man who is close to the stage of transcending tribulation!
His death was tantamount to the breaking of a rough arm of the royal family, and even the current emperor Xie Tianlong felt heartbroken.
Everyone's eyes were turned to the little eunuch, which made him fall to his knees and kowtow continuously.
"Xingxiu Prime Minister saw a vision of purple energy flashing across the Liang Kingdom, and thought that a treasure was born, so he couldn't help but want to deduce it."
"I didn't expect it to be so direct..."
With the little eunuch's narration, everyone present understood the whole story.
"It is capable of killing stars and eating them to death. The grade of this treasure may be at the heaven level. Dear dears, what do you think?"
Xie Tianlong was wearing a yellow robe and surrounded by dragon aura. The prime minister's death made him feel extremely angry.
The terrifying pressure was like an ancient sacred mountain, which made all the five major families lower their heads and their bones crackled.
"Your Majesty, you said that this treasure is at the heaven level, how can we get our hands on it." An elder from the Ye family stood up, terrified.
The faces of the other four major families all had the same dead faces as the Ye family.
With such an attitude, Xie Tianlong understood that they all had their own agenda, and waved his sleeves to signal them to retreat.
"Prime Minister Xingxiu has made great contributions for many years, and the whole city mourned for three days when he was buried lavishly."
After arranging the stars, Xie Tianlong decisively summoned another prime minister in the palace who was deducing the secrets of heaven.
Although the strength of Zhouxing is only in the late stage of integration, the power of deduction is only slightly inferior to that of Xingxiu.
"See your Majesty." Zhou Xing walked into the hall and bowed to pay homage.
"As a Tianji master, I won't give you any nonsense. Let's deduce it."
"Poof!"
As soon as Xie Tianlong's voice fell, the sound of kneeling down echoed throughout the palace.
This sound seemed to be made deliberately, and the sound was quite loud, followed closely by the cry of pear blossoms with rain.
"Your Majesty, please take back your life. The stars are all gone. There are seniors and juniors among my subordinates. I still don't want to die!!"
The sound of begging for mercy echoed in the palace, which made Xie Tianlong have a dark look on his face, and he didn't understand why the other party had such a big reaction.
"I'm just asking you to deduce whether the five major families will gain something from this trip?"
"So that's it. I thought His Majesty wanted to..."
"What do you think it is?" Xie Tianlong stepped forward and asked.
"It's okay, it's okay, let's deduce it." Zhou Xing waved his hand quickly, and then a blue sphere the size of a palm appeared in his hand.
Looking closer, it looks like a vast galaxy wandering.
"Galaxy Tianji Ball, help me!"
Zhou Xing closed his eyes, the power of cause and effect covered the entire palace, and a picture appeared in his mind.
Xie Tianlong sat on the dragon chair, resting his hand on the side of his face and waiting quietly.
About two-quarters of an hour later, Zhou Xing opened his eyes and said flatteringly: "Hey, hey, these five major families are just in vain. They can't even find a hair, and they may make a mess."
In this way, Xie Tianlong breathed a sigh of relief. Just when he was about to continue speaking, Zhou Xing stretched out his finger and interrupted quickly.
"Your Majesty would like to ask how it would be if you went to harvest it yourself!"
"It's a pity that even though His Majesty has the blessing of dragon energy, it's still a waste of time. According to my calculation, that treasure has been taken away by a powerful man whose strength far exceeds ours."
Zhou Xing was very proud and spoke plausibly.
